headline: A one-owner custom home on a Sugar Mill Pond corner lot
description:
Welcome to 101 Tortola Lane, a one-owner custom home on a desirable corner lot in Sugar Mill Pond. More than just a house, this is a home designed for gathering, entertaining, and enjoying the everyday moments that make a place truly special. Beyond the home itself, Sugar Mill Pond offers a lifestyle that is hard to replicate.

The spacious living room features a wood-burning fireplace and opens to the dining area, creating the perfect setting for dinner around the table, lingering conversations, and evenings with family and friends. At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen features a large island that naturally becomes the center of the action. The adjoining family room features brick floors and walls that add warmth and character. A nearby flex room with custom cabinetry is equipped for an additional refrigerator/freezer as well as a dishwasher or beverage cooler.

The primary suite overlooks the side yard and pool through two French doors, with flexible space for a sitting area, office, or reading nook. The ensuite bath features a soaking tub, separate shower, dual vanities, and a walk-in closet with convenient access to the laundry room. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath complete the home.

Step outside to an inviting retreat designed to unwind or entertain, with a covered patio, resort-style pool, and hot tub. Sugar Mill Pond's health club, pond, neighborhood pool, park, restaurants, shops, grocery, schools, and medical facilities are all just minutes away.

101 Tortola Lane is a home with thoughtful spaces, timeless character, and a setting that truly allows you to enjoy the best of Sugar Mill Pond. Come experience it for yourself.
features: One-owner custom home on a desirable corner lot
Living room with wood-burning fireplace, open to the dining area
Chef's kitchen with a large center island
Family room with brick floors and brick walls
Flex room with custom cabinetry, equipped for an extra refrigerator/freezer and a dishwasher or beverage cooler
Primary suite with two French doors overlooking the pool
Ensuite bath with soaking tub, separate shower, and dual vanities
Walk-in closet with direct access to the laundry room
Covered patio, resort-style pool, and hot tub
Minutes from Sugar Mill Pond's health club, pond, park, shops, and dining
neighborhoodText: A Youngsville community with a pond and boardwalk, neighborhood pool, parks and playgrounds, and restaurants, shops, and a health club close to home.

headline: Just under half an acre to build your dream home in Delmar Estates
description:
A rare opportunity to build your dream home on this 0.47-acre lot in Delmar Estates. Just under half an acre, this lot provides plenty of room to bring your vision to life. Conveniently located near Johnston Street, with easy access to dining, shopping, and everyday amenities. See the potential for yourself - schedule your showing today!

The lot is zoned residential for a single-family home and fronts a paved city street, with public water from Lafayette Parish Water District North and electricity and cable available. Schools are Ridge Elementary, Edgar Martin Middle, and Comeaux High in Lafayette Parish.
features: 0.47-acre residential lot (20,473 sq ft) in Delmar Estates
Public water (Lafayette Parish Water District North); private sewer
Zoned residential for a single-family home
Subdivision building covenants apply; lot may not be subdivided
Near Johnston Street dining, shopping, and everyday amenities
